# Game Idea: Space Survivor

- **Genre:** Arcade / Endless runner
- **Core mechanic:** Control a ship on an HTML canvas that can thrust and rotate to dodge incoming asteroids.
- **Lose condition:** The ship collides with an asteroid or leaves the canvas bounds.
- **Goal:** Survive as long as possible and rack up points for each asteroid avoided.

1: // Simple Space Survivor game
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) {
7:     console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found.');
8:     return;
9:   }
10:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
11:   // Set canvas size to fill its container or use defined size
12:   canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
13:   // Initialize background stars
14:   initStars();
15:   canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
16: 
17:   // ----- Ship -----
18:   // ----- Starfield -----
19: const starsCount = 200;
20: const stars = [];
21: function initStars() {
22:   stars.length = 0;
23:   for (let i = 0; i < starsCount; i++) {
24:     stars.push({
25:       x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
26:       y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
27:       r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
28:     });
29:   }
30: }
31: function drawStars() {
32:   ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
33:   for (const s of stars) {
34:     ctx.beginPath();
35:     ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
36:     ctx.fill();
37:   }
38: }
39: 
40: // Draw background gradient
41: function drawBackground() {
42:   const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
43:   grad.addColorStop(0, '#0a0a30'); // dark navy
44:   grad.addColorStop(1, '#000'); // black
45:   ctx.fillStyle = grad;
46:   ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
47: }
48: 
49: // Draw asteroid with rotation and irregular shape
50: function drawAsteroid(a) {
51:   ctx.save();
52:   ctx.translate(a.x, a.y);
53:   ctx.rotate(a.angle);
54:   ctx.fillStyle = a.color;
55:   // Create a rough rock shape using polygon with jittered radii
56:   const points = 8;
57:   ctx.beginPath();
58:   for (let i = 0; i < points; i++) {
59:     const theta = (i / points) * Math.PI * 2;
60:     const jitter = (Math.random() - 0.5) * a.r * 0.3;
61:     const radius = a.r + jitter;
62:     const x = Math.cos(theta) * radius;
63:     const y = Math.sin(theta) * radius;
64:     if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
65:     else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
66:   }
67:   ctx.closePath();
68:   ctx.fill();
69:   ctx.restore();
70: }
71: // ----- Ship -----
72: // ----- Ship -----
73: // ----- Ship -----
74: const ship = {
75:   x: canvas.width / 2,
76:   y: canvas.height / 2,
77:   r: 12, // radius for collision
78:   angle: 0, // radians
79:   vx: 0,
80:   vy: 0,
81:   thrust: 0.1,
82:   rotateSpeed: 0.07,
83:   color: 'white',
84:   // flag for thrust flame
85:   thrusting: false,
86: };
87: 
88: // Draw ship with optional thrust flame
89: function drawShip() {
90:   ctx.save();
91:   ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
92:   ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
93:   // Ship body
94:   ctx.fillStyle = ship.color;
95:   ctx.beginPath();
96:   ctx.moveTo(ship.r, 0);
97:   ctx.lineTo(-ship.r, ship.r / 2);
98:   ctx.lineTo(-ship.r, -ship.r / 2);
99:   ctx.closePath();
100:   ctx.fill();
101:   // Thrust flame
102:   if (ship.thrusting) {
103:     ctx.fillStyle = 'orange';
104:     ctx.beginPath();
105:     ctx.moveTo(-ship.r, -ship.r / 3);
106:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.r - 8, 0);
107:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.r, ship.r / 3);
108:     ctx.closePath();
109:     ctx.fill();
110:   }
111:   ctx.restore();
112: }
113: 
114:   // ----- Asteroids -----
115:   const asteroids = [];
116:   const asteroidSpawnInterval = 1500; // ms
117:   const maxAsteroidSize = 30;
118:   const minAsteroidSize = 10;
119:   let lastSpawn = 0;
120: 
121:   // ----- Input handling -----
122:   const keys = {};
123:   // Sound assets
124:   const thrustSound = new Audio('thrust.mp3');
125:   thrustSound.loop = true;
126:   const explosionSound = new Audio('explosion.mp3');
127:   const bgMusic = new Audio('bgmusic.mp3');
128:   bgMusic.loop = true;
129:   bgMusic.volume = 0.3;
130:   bgMusic.play().catch(() => {}); // start background music silently if allowed
131: 
132:   window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
133:     keys[e.code] = true;
134:     if (e.code === 'ArrowUp') {
135:       if (thrustSound.paused) {
136:         thrustSound.currentTime = 0;
137:         thrustSound.play().catch(() => {});
138:       }
139:     }
140:   });
141:   window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
142:     keys[e.code] = false;
143:     if (e.code === 'ArrowUp') {
144:       thrustSound.pause();
145:       thrustSound.currentTime = 0;
146:     }
147:   });
148: 
149:   // ----- Game state -----
150:   let score = 0;
151:   let gameOver = false;
152: 
153:     function update(dt) {
154:       // Update starfield (slow drift)
155:       for (const s of stars) {
156:         s.x += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.1;
157:         s.y += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.1;
158:         if (s.x < 0) s.x += canvas.width;
159:         if (s.x > canvas.width) s.x -= canvas.width;
160:         if (s.y < 0) s.y += canvas.height;
161:         if (s.y > canvas.height) s.y -= canvas.height;
162:       }
163:       // Rotate asteroids for visual variety
164:       for (const a of asteroids) {
165:         a.angle += a.rotateSpeed;
166:       }
167: 
168: 
169:     if (gameOver) return;
170: 
171:     // Ship rotation
172:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.angle -= ship.rotateSpeed;
173:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.angle += ship.rotateSpeed;
174:     // Ship thrust
175:     if (keys['ArrowUp']) {
176:       ship.vx += Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.thrust;
177:       ship.vy += Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.thrust;
178:       ship.thrusting = true;
179:     } else {
180:       ship.thrusting = false;
181:     }
182:     // Apply velocity
183:     ship.x += ship.vx;
184:     ship.y += ship.vy;
185:     // Simple friction
186:     ship.vx *= 0.99;
187:     ship.vy *= 0.99;
188: 
189:     // Boundary check – losing condition if leaves canvas
190:     if (
191:       ship.x < 0 || ship.x > canvas.width ||
192:       ship.y < 0 || ship.y > canvas.height
193:     ) {
194:       gameOver = true; explosionSound.play().catch(()=>{});
195:     }
196: 
197:     // Spawn asteroids
198:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > asteroidSpawnInterval) {
199:       spawnAsteroid();
200:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
201:     }
202: 
203:     // Update asteroids
204:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
205:       const a = asteroids[i];
206:       a.x += a.vx;
207:       a.y += a.vy;
208:       // Remove when off-screen
209:       if (
210:         a.x < -a.r || a.x > canvas.width + a.r ||
211:         a.y < -a.r || a.y > canvas.height + a.r
212:       ) {
213:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
214:         score++; // survived an asteroid
215:         continue;
216:       }
217:       // Collision with ship
218:       const dx = a.x - ship.x;
219:       const dy = a.y - ship.y;
220:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
221:       if (dist < a.r + ship.r) {
222:         gameOver = true; explosionSound.play().catch(()=>{});
223:         break;
224:       }
225:     }
226:   }
227: 
228:   function spawnAsteroid() {
229:   // Random rotation for visual variety
230:   const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
231:   const rotateSpeed = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.02;
232:     const r = Math.random() * (maxAsteroidSize - minAsteroidSize) + minAsteroidSize;
233:     // Random edge
234:     const edge = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
235:     let x, y, vx, vy;
236:     const speed = Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5;
237:     switch (edge) {
238:       case 0: // top
239:         x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
240:         y = -r;
241:         vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
242:         vy = speed;
243:         break;
244:       case 1: // right
245:         x = canvas.width + r;
246:         y = Math.random() * canvas.height;
247:         vx = -speed;
248:         vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
249:         break;
250:       case 2: // bottom
251:         x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
252:         y = canvas.height + r;
253:         vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
254:         vy = -speed;
255:         break;
256:       case 3: // left
257:         x = -r;
258:         y = Math.random() * canvas.height;
259:         vx = speed;
260:         vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
261:         break;
262:     }
263:     asteroids.push({ x, y, vx, vy, r, color: 'gray', angle, rotateSpeed });
264:   }
265: 
266:   function draw() {
267:     // Clear
268:     // Draw background gradient
269:     drawBackground();
270:     // Draw starfield background
271:     drawStars();
272: 
273:     // Ship
274:     drawShip();
275: 
276:     // Asteroids
277:     for (const a of asteroids) {
278:       drawAsteroid(a);
279:     }
280: 
281:     // UI
282:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
283:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
284:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
285:     if (gameOver) {
286:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
287:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
288:     }
289:   }
290: 
291:   let lastTime = 0;
292:   function loop(timestamp) {
293:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
294:     lastTime = timestamp;
295:     update(dt);
296:     draw();
297:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
298:   }
299:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
300: })();
